papers.title: AUTONOMOUS ROBOTS FOR EVERYDAY LIVING FAMILY 29 / F141-F145 | SCIENTIFIC & TECHNICAL NOTEBOOK | RESEARCH WORKING EDITION v1.0 33 x STARLI | WHITE RAINBOW RESEARCH LIBRARY This prospective and nonclinical work addresses domestic task cooperation, explicit personal adaptation, verified human safety, qualified module repair and revocable household permissions. It contains research hypotheses and synthetic geometry, not certified product behavior, clinical efficacy or authorization to record people. An independent resident veto is part of the engineering problem. Five official flagship research titles F141 | Distributed Cooperation of Domestic Service Robots at the Limit | 家庭服務機器人分散式協作的極限 F142 | Personal Needs Adaptation in Everyday Robotics at the Limit | 生活機器人個人需求自適應的極限 F143 | Safe Human–Robot Coexistence in Everyday Service Robotics at the Limit | 生活服務機器人安全人機共處的極限 F144 | Autonomous Maintenance and Component Replacement of Domestic Robots at the Limit | 家庭機器人自主維修與零件替換的極限 F145 | Privacy Protection and Autonomy Boundaries in Everyday Service Robotics at the Limit | 生活服務機器人隱私保護與自主權限的極限 Five concurrent evidence tracks 1 / Freeze research DNA: independent household mechanisms, explicit residents and rooms, physical baselines, negative outcomes and no hidden service/consent claims. 2 / Formalize mechanistic models: dimensionally interpretable task, speed, force, module and permission equations with 42 recomputable 3D synthetic hypothesis surfaces. 3 / Reconstruct external witnesses: real task receipts, independent motion traces, accessibility gauges, post-repair calibration and local/cloud data flow scans. 4 / Challenge competing worlds: manual preferences, simpler single robots, conservative fixed-speed safety, trained repair and offline least-privilege automation. 5 / Audit and permit transfer: retain every rejected task, near miss, user objection, unexpected actuator movement and deleted-data counterexample for blind successor replication. Research source genealogy and evidence taxonomy The user-supplied 915-page SWARM MANUFACTURING & ROBOTIC MATTER AT THE LIMIT is the available mother PDF. Its agent capabilities (Ch. 9-16), task coordination (Ch. 17-24), fault tolerance and independent verification (Ch. 49-56), modular reconfiguration (Ch. 57-64), human-swarm interaction (Ch. 72) and authority (Ch. 76-82) motivate this domestic adaptation. These are chapter trajectories of ONE book, not three different supplied mother volumes. ISO 13482:2014 and ISO/TR 23482-1:2020 inform safety questions; edition 2 was under publication on 15 Nov 2026. Neither standards nor literature certify the unbuilt prototypes.

papers.title: DIGITAL TWINS OF SUSTAINABLE LIVING CIVILIZATIONS FAMILY 32 / F156-F160 | SCIENTIFIC & TECHNICAL NOTEBOOK | PROSPECTIVE WORKING EDITION v1.0 33 x STARLI | WHITE RAINBOW RESEARCH LIBRARY A credible civilization digital twin is not a colorful urban dashboard. This prospective scientific text separates independently metered resource states, physically coupled energy-water-food systems, complete external-dependency ledgers, life-cycle carbon and material inventories, and truly held-out environmental performance validation. All 3D surfaces are synthetic demonstrations, not field measurements. Human authority, privacy and essential-service guarantees remain binding even if a model appears accurate. Five formal flagships in the 200-theme source blueprint F156 | Multiresource Digital Twins of Sustainable Habitats at the Limit | 永續居住文明多資源數位孿生的極限 F157 | Coupled Energy-Water-Food Simulation for Smart Communities at the Limit | 智慧社區能源水源食物耦合模擬的極限 F158 | Measuring External Dependencies of Self-Sufficient Living Systems at the Limit | 自給型生活系統外部依賴量測的極限 F159 | Carbon and Material Footprint Reconstruction for Sustainable Living Civilizations at the Limit | 永續生活文明碳排與材料足跡重建的極限 F160 | Validating Sustainable Living Digital Twins Against Environmental Performance at the Limit | 永續生活數位孿生預測與實際環境績效驗證的極限 Five parallel scientific evidence tracks Track I / Research DNA freeze: make resource boundaries, external inputs, functional units, critical users and human authority explicit before modeling any benefit. Track II / Mechanistic mathematics: 30 dimensioned candidate relations, 42 synthetic 3D response surfaces and five independent conservation or decision frameworks, never a numerical substitute for experimental data. Track III / Independent witness: calibrated meters for electricity and water, real crop outputs, imported supply receipts, cradle-to-grave material inventories and locked held-out forecast records. Track IV / Competing worlds: unseen pumping energy, omitted cloud infrastructure, inventory double counting, displaced carbon, retrospective data leakage, severe minority-service failures and controller cybersecurity compromise. Track V / QA and release: preserve negative cases and all figures, share reproducible synthetic grids, pre-register fair strong baselines, review outside evidence, and allow later researchers to reject the initial interpretation. Mother-book research lineage and evidence boundary The user-provided 915-page SWARM MANUFACTURING & ROBOTIC MATTER AT THE LIMIT is the directly available mother research work. Its traceable lineages include Chapter 12 Energy, Payload, and Duty Cycle; Chapter 20 Communication-Limited Manufacturing; Chapter 35 Material Handoffs Across Robot Networks; Chapter 62 Morphology as a Manufacturing Resource; Chapter 73 Scaling Laws for Million-Agent Manufacturing; Chapter 75 Energy Economics of Distributed Production; Chapter 77 Digital Twins for Multi-Robot Manufacturing; and Chapter 82 Toward a Manufacturing Ecology of Autonomous Matter. The present work expands these mechanisms into a new living-systems hypothesis; it does not pretend those mother chapters already proved urban resource performance. External methodological research is listed at the end and can be independently checked.
